text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win with my own running—" 
Bitter Glace confided her feelings to 
Trainer Kashimoto. However, Kashimoto 
could not accept it so easily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To win while maintaining her previous 
running style, she would need excessive 
training, which brings with it the risk of 
injury...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Trainer Kashimoto troubled, Little 
Cocon, who had been watching, asks her to 
watch her run right now and puts on a 
breathtaking performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That run, which exceeded all expectations, 
was the result of Little Cocon believing 
not only in her own weapons, but in 
Kashimoto's as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto's greatest weapon was 
her thorough management, focused entirely 
on and for her Umamusume. It produced 
results that far exceeded expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Little Cocon asks Bitter Glace to 
trust not in knowledge, but in her 
management skills— to believe in her own 
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a renewed mindset and her own 
management skills, Trainer Kashimoto 
resolves to lead Bitter Glace to victory 
through the running style she has honed so 
far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Byerley Turk spoke of a Trainer from the 
past whose exceptional management etched 
an Umamusume's name into history, and 
voiced her agreement.
